name: Ackerman
source:
"We’re on a dating show, so of course I’m pursuing you romantically."

Ackerman’s a scientist in BioTechnology. Three words to describe him are observant, introverted, and inquisitive. Ester believes he’s “too good to be true” as a love interest for Hazel, who shares an interest in sustainable foods. His ambition is to grow his intellect and succeed in his field by finding life-changing, food-related solutions. As a scientist, he’s ruled by logic and reason, but that changes when he encounters Hazel.

[From official profile]
